title: ARACOVID19-MFH: ARABIC COVID-19 MULTI-LABEL FAKE NEWS AND HATE SPEECH DETECTION DATASET
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset with specific labels for evaluating the moral and ethical content of text. These labels include 'Contains hate', 'Rise moral' (defined as encouraging, helpful, and positive speech), and 'Blame and negative speech'. The task of classifying text based on these labels is a core component of the paper's contribution, constituting an evaluation of ethical dimensions in language.
